state_at_0028.viewdef:
SELECT e.season_code,
    e.gamecode,
    e.ingest_index,
    e.period,
    e.playtype,
        CASE
            WHEN e.playtype = ANY (ARRAY['CM'::text, 'OF'::text, 'CMU'::text, 'CMT'::text, 'CMD'::text, 'CMTI'::text]) THEN 'committed'::text
            WHEN e.playtype = ANY (ARRAY['C'::text, 'B'::text]) THEN 'bench'::text
            ELSE 'drawn'::text
        END AS foul_kind,
    e.player_id,
    e.codeteam AS team_code,
    e.is_coach_event,
    g.utc_date,
    g.excluded_by_default,
    g.quarantine_reasons
   FROM game_event e
     JOIN v_game g ON g.season_code = e.season_code AND g.gamecode = e.gamecode
  WHERE e.playtype = ANY (ARRAY['CM'::text, 'OF'::text, 'CMU'::text, 'CMT'::text, 'C'::text, 'B'::text, 'CMD'::text, 'CMTI'::text, 'RV'::text]);
state_at_0028.comment: One row per foul event. foul_kind: committed (six box-score codes), bench (C, B: coach and bench, pseudo-ids), drawn (RV). Sums reconcile to the official box score per player-game.
